title: 基于ASR对齐与停顿建模的运动神经元病患者言语流畅性指数自动评估
summary: 本研究提出一种自动估计言语流畅性指数（VFI）的系统，用于监测运动神经元病（MND）患者的认知障碍。系统结合WhisperX语音识别与Silero语音活动检测，并优化时间戳，在独特MND数据集上预测VFI并提取临床可解释指标，性能优于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入方法，最佳模型P-words R²达0.9。
summary_en: This study proposes a system for automatically estimating the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) to monitor cognitive impairment in people with Motor Neuron Disease (MND). Combining WhisperX ASR and Silero VAD with refined timestamping on a unique MND dataset, it predicts VFI and extracts clinically interpretable measures, outperforming traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, with best models achieving R² 0.9 for P-words.
